items.text: Reach out to family to confirm pharmacy and PCP, along with insurance information
Nursing assessment completed (ALF appropriateness)
Confirm time of care received; 1823/POC received with signed medication list
POC / 1823 approved by the AD or WD
Signed Medication form on file (required before any physical move-in)
Discuss medications, expectations and the move-in process with family
Welcome Home sign on their door with name
Record Red Carpet welcome for new resident; provide to Lifestyles
New Resident Notification form completed for managers and care associates
New resident admission checklist completed / set up
Floor nurse meets with resident to confirm medications
Provide pendant and explain how to use it
Resident photo taken; provided to business office
Escort resident to apartment with ED and tour the amenities
Resident added to housekeeping schedule
Confirm dining preferences, seat assignment, and any special diets / allergies
Confirm monthly calendar is provided
Move resident into Yardi; confirm physical date and financial dates match
Set up ACH; confirm financial file is complete with all required documents
Signed forms disbursed to specific departments as needed
Permanent nameplate for apartment ordered
Complete an in-person follow-up with family
Greet resident; ask how they are feeling about their first week
Ask the resident about their likes to get to know them
Confirm resident name displayed on plaque outside apartment
Discuss check-in / check-out process with the resident
Confirm resident's room is satisfactory
Discuss fire drills, emergency exits, and how to put in a work order request
Request permission to help the resident submit a 5-star Google review
Dietary director introduces themselves and reviews the dining plan (1-2 weeks)
Maintenance director check-in and answers any questions (1-2 weeks)
